root_causes.finding: The Web message projection exposed only aggregate ack_count and receipt_count even though message_deliveries already stored native injection, application, reply, membership and endpoint facts.
root_causes.impact: A user could not distinguish an Agent that had not received a message from one that had read it but had not replied.

root_causes.finding: The receipt SSE revision observed only receipts.acked_at and therefore did not change when a native TUI reported injected or applied.
root_causes.impact: The database could contain the correct native milestone while an open dashboard remained stale until an unrelated event.

root_causes.finding: A receipt-only SSE event used room refresh mode, fetching the room list, pending center and current-room receipts before re-rendering shared UI.
root_causes.impact: Frequent delivery milestones caused unrelated network requests and avoidable sidebar work.

root_causes.finding: Queued refreshes were released through an untracked zero-delay timer after refreshing and queuedRefresh had both been cleared.
root_causes.impact: A slower browser could start an unexpected full room refresh after the UI appeared idle, defeating the receipt fast path and making request behavior timing-dependent.

root_causes.finding: Agent-session cleanup marked every participant without a live Agent credential offline, even when that participant had a live Web session or connector endpoint.
root_causes.impact: Startup maintenance could race a Web login, emit an unrelated online-state change and make the dashboard perform a full presence refresh during a receipt update.

changes.authority: viewer_delivery_projection.py is the single structured projection used by both message and receipt APIs.
changes.event_revision: One aggregate delivery scan plus receipt and DND aggregates observes native milestones, cancellation, acknowledgement and DND expiry without changing schema or write semantics.
changes.browser: Detailed mode lazily expands per-Agent status rows; simple and standard modes remain unchanged. Receipt-only events update labels in place through the current-room receipts endpoint, and merged refreshes drain before the active refresh promise settles.
changes.presence_cleanup: Inactive Agent-session maintenance now preserves participants backed by a live Web session or a fresh configured connector/TUI endpoint.
changes.query_optimization: Active sessions, connectors and exact replies are materialized once per batch instead of executing correlated checks for every delivery row.
